name: io.github.flashdata-dev/youtube-download
title: YouTube Download to Cloud Storage — FlashData
description: Deliver YouTube video, audio or clips to your cloud storage asynchronously. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with youtube_download access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Deliver a YouTube clip to S3 or customer cloud storage
dev.flashdata.useResult: Submit once, save the returned id, and call get_job with job_id until job.status is completed. Read output.results[0] for file_url, file_size, downloaded_bytes and output_format. Pending or processing is not completed delivery.
dev.flashdata.limits: Only asynchronous delivery is supported. Supply your own destination and credentials; media access and retention follow your storage settings. Private object URLs are not public download links. Charges reserve Credits and settle by uploaded bytes.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
